verdict.rationale: Visa Intelligent Commerce ships developer-facing software (an agent toolkit, an MCP server on npm, and APIs), so a telemetry or usage-tracking opt-out is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack never mentions telemetry, analytics collection, or any opt-out control. The documented consumer consent features cover payment mandates and sharing identifiers with merchants, which is a different capability from opting out of usage tracking and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
